raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

MiniMax-H3 DiT attention uses a **packed varlen** path (`[text | cond | audio | video]`, `cu_seqlens=[0, used, total]`). The existing `sla_attn` backend only implements dense `forward()`, not `forward_varlen()`, so H3 admission (`validate_server_args` requires `packed_varlen=True`) rejects `sla_attn` today.

The official[ LightX2V Turbo-SLA](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo-SLA) stack has two layers that should not be conflated:

| Component | Role |
|---|---|
| **SLA LoRA** | Standard QKV/FFN LoRA merged into `W`; drives few-step generation quality |
| **`sla_attn` kernel** | Runtime block-sparse attention acceleration; no sparse weights in the checkpoint |

Goal: let H3 opt into `sla_attn` for DiT acceleration **without breaking existing `sla_attn` users such as TurboWan**, and correctly handle the fact that text/cond/audio prefixes in the packed sequence must not be dropped by top-k sparsification.

---

## Changes

**1. Backend — `sparse_linear_attn.py`**

- `forward_varlen()` + `_packed_sla_forward()` for H3 `[T,H,D]` packed layout
- `protect_upto` pins prefix K blocks; `_localize_protect_upto` maps global bounds per segment
- `_resolve_sla_impl_config()`: config overrides only unset/default ctor fields
- `linear_mix=false` skips `proj_l` (H3 path); shared defaults stay 128×64, `topk=0.1`

 H3 config: `topk_ratio=0.15,blkq=64,blkk=64,linear_mix=false`

**2. Kernel — `sparse_linear_attn_triton.py`**

- `get_block_map(..., protect_upto=0)` pins prefix blocks
- `topk = max(1, ...)`; GQA `repeat_interleave` fix

**3.H3 wiring — `minimax_h3.py`**

- `protect_upto` from `audio_pos.max()+1`, passed only for `SLA_ATTN`
- Ulysses keeps global token coordinates (A2A before attention)

---

## Impact on other models

- **Default `sla_attn` (e.g. TurboWan):** unchanged — same 128×64, `topk=0.1`, `proj_l`
- **Other backends (FA / Sage / SDPA):** no change
- **H3:** enabled via `forward_varlen` + admission probe; no pipeline whitelist

---

## Testing

End-to-end — FL2VA + Turbo-SLA LoRA (768p / 5s / 6 steps / merge, official HF DiT)

- Model & FL2VA keyframes: [MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3) (`assets/fl2va.mp4` first/last frames)
- Turbo-SLA LoRA: [lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo-SLA](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo-SLA)


| Case | Task | Backend | Steps | LoRA | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base sanity | FL2VA | FA | **20** | none | Official HF DiT only (`--dit none`); confirms base packed-varlen path |
| Turbo few-step | FL2VA | FA or `sla_attn` | **6** | Turbo-SLA merge | Same recipe; swap `--attn` only for SLA check (`topk_ratio=0.15`) |

Both at 768p / 5s, DiT resident (`--no-layerwise`).


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5cdfca62-9b0d-48c1-9d6e-6f071ec33fd9


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6e1894d7-f4ff-4357-80ed-869df6f40f23


---

## Test plan (CI / reviewer)

- [x] `test_minimax_h3_admission::test_validate_server_args_accepts_sla_attn` passes
- [ ] `test_sla_varlen` (follow-up PR or same PR if added later)
- [ ] Default `SparseLinearAttentionImpl()` still has `proj_l`, `128×64`, `topk=0.1`
- [ ] H3 can generate with `attention_backend=sla_attn` + `attention_backend_config=topk_ratio=0.15,blkq=64,blkk=64,linear_mix=false`
- [ ] Wan regression: default-config SLA behavior unchanged (if a Wan CI case exists)
- [ ] Ulysses + SLA integration (not covered by unit tests yet; global `protect_upto` contract is documented)

**Lint (changed files):** `pre-commit` hooks pass (`ruff` F401/F821/UP037, `isort`, `black`, codespell, multimodal_gen Chinese-char check).

---

## Notes

- **Few-step quality comes from LoRA merge, not the SLA kernel**; the SLA kernel is mainly an attention speedup (and may be slower on very short schedules)
- H3 must use the **official HF 13-shard DiT**; a Comfy single-file overlay on this CLI path produces gray mud (unrelated to SLA)
- `--steps 6` means 5 denoise updates (sigmas include endpoint 0)
- Plain top-k without `protect_upto` drops most of the audio prefix blocks; always enable prefix pinning for H3 packed layout

@@ -8,16 +8,33 @@
 import triton.language as tl
 
 
-def get_block_map(q, k, topk_ratio, BLKQ=64, BLKK=64):
+def get_block_map(q, k, topk_ratio, BLKQ=64, BLKK=64, protect_upto=0):
     arg_k = k - torch.mean(
         k, dim=-2, keepdim=True
     )  # smooth-k technique in SageAttention
     pooled_qblocks = mean_pool(q, BLKQ)
     pooled_kblocks = mean_pool(arg_k, BLKK)
+
+    num_q_heads = q.size(1)
+    num_kv_heads = k.size(1)
+    if num_q_heads != num_kv_heads:
+        if num_q_heads % num_kv_heads:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Q heads ({num_q_heads}) must be divisible by KV heads ({num_kv_heads})"
+            )
+        pooled_kblocks = pooled_kblocks.repeat_interleave(
+            num_q_heads // num_kv_heads, dim=1
+        )
+
     pooled_score = pooled_qblocks @ pooled_kblocks.transpose(-1, -2)
 
     K = pooled_score.shape[-1]
-    topk = min(K, int(topk_ratio * K))
+    topk = max(1, min(K, int(topk_ratio * K)))
+    if protect_upto > 0:
+        n_pinned = min((int(protect_upto) + BLKK - 1) // BLKK, K)
+        if n_pinned > 0:
+            pooled_score[..., :n_pinned] = float("inf")
+            topk = min(K, topk + n_pinned)
     lut = torch.topk(pooled_score, topk, dim=-1, sorted=False).indices
 
     sparse_map = torch.zeros_like(pooled_score, dtype=torch.int8)

@@ -23,6 +23,7 @@
 import torch.nn.functional as F
 import triton
 
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import _attn_fwd, get_block_map
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.attention_backend import (
     AttentionBackend,
     AttentionImpl,
@@ -34,9 +35,168 @@
 
 logger = init_logger(__name__)
 
-
 # ==================================SLA Functions===================================
-from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion import _attn_fwd, get_block_map
+
+_DEFAULT_SLA_TOPK_RATIO = 0.1
+_DEFAULT_SLA_BLKQ = 128
+_DEFAULT_SLA_BLKK = 64
+_DEFAULT_SLA_LINEAR_MIX = True
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _SLAImplConfig:
+    topk_ratio: float
+    BLKQ: int
+    BLKK: int
+    linear_mix: bool
+
+
+def _resolve_sla_impl_config(
+    *,
+    topk_ratio: float = _DEFAULT_SLA_TOPK_RATIO,
+    BLKQ: int = _DEFAULT_SLA_BLKQ,
+    BLKK: int = _DEFAULT_SLA_BLKK,
+    linear_mix: bool | None = None,
+) -> _SLAImplConfig:
+    """Merge ctor args with ``attention_backend_config`` for unset/default fields only."""
+    resolved_linear_mix = (
+        _DEFAULT_SLA_LINEAR_MIX if linear_mix is None else bool(linear_mix)
+    )
+    cfg: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    try:
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.server_args import get_global_server_args
+
+        raw = getattr(get_global_server_args(), "attention_backend_config", None)
+        if isinstance(raw, dict):
+            cfg = raw
+    except ValueError:
+        pass
+
+    if topk_ratio == _DEFAULT_SLA_TOPK_RATIO:
+        if "topk_ratio" in cfg:
+            topk_ratio = float(cfg["topk_ratio"])
+        elif "sparsity_ratio" in cfg:
+            topk_ratio = 1.0 - float(cfg["sparsity_ratio"])
+
+    if BLKQ == _DEFAULT_SLA_BLKQ and BLKK == _DEFAULT_SLA_BLKK:
+        if "blkq" in cfg or "block_size" in cfg:
+            blkq = int(cfg.get("blkq", cfg.get("block_size", BLKQ)))
+            BLKQ = blkq
+            BLKK = int(cfg.get("blkk", 64 if blkq == 128 else blkq))
+
+    if linear_mix is None and "linear_mix" in cfg:
+        value = cfg["linear_mix"]
+        if isinstance(value, str):
+            resolved_linear_mix = value.strip().lower() in {
+                "1",
+                "true",
+                "yes",
+                "on",
+            }
+        else:
+            resolved_linear_mix = bool(value)
+
+    if not 0.0 < topk_ratio <= 1.0:
+        raise ValueError(f"SLA topk_ratio must be in (0, 1], got {topk_ratio}")
+
+    return _SLAImplConfig(
+        topk_ratio=topk_ratio,
+        BLKQ=BLKQ,
+        BLKK=BLKK,
+        linear_mix=resolved_linear_mix,
+    )
+
+
+def _clamp_protect_upto(n: int, seq_len: int) -> int:
+    if n <= 0:
+        return 0
+    return min(n, seq_len)
+
+
+def _localize_protect_upto(
+    protect_upto: int,
+    *,
+    segment_start: int,
+    segment_len: int,
+) -> int:
+    """Map a packed-layout token bound to a segment-local prefix length."""
+    if protect_upto <= segment_start or segment_len <= 0:
+        return 0
+    return min(protect_upto - segment_start, segment_len)
+
+
+def _trailing_padding_used_len(
+    *,
+    total_tokens: int,
+    max_seqlen: int,
+    bounds: tuple[int, ...],
+) -> int | None:
+    if len(bounds) != 3:
+        return None
+    start, used, total = bounds
+    if start != 0 or used >= total or total != total_tokens or used != max_seqlen:
+        return None
+    return used
+
+
+def _packed_sla_forward(
+    impl: AttentionImpl,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    key: torch.Tensor,
+    value: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    bounds: tuple[int, ...],
+    max_seqlen: int,
+    protect_upto: int = 0,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    used = _trailing_padding_used_len(
+        total_tokens=query.shape[0],
+        max_seqlen=max_seqlen,
+        bounds=bounds,
+    )
+    if used is not None:
+        metadata = SparseLinearAttentionMetadata(
+            current_timestep=0,
+            topk_ratio=impl.topk_ratio,
+            protect_upto=_localize_protect_upto(
+                protect_upto,
+                segment_start=0,
+                segment_len=used,
+            ),
+        )
+        live_out = impl.forward(
+            query[:used].unsqueeze(0),
+            key[:used].unsqueeze(0),
+            value[:used].unsqueeze(0),
+            metadata,
+        )[0]
+        if used == query.shape[0]:
+            return live_out
+        output = torch.zeros_like(query)
+        output[:used] = live_out
+        return output
+
+    output = torch.empty_like(query)
+    for start, stop in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
+        if start == stop:
+            continue
+        segment_len = stop - start
+        metadata = SparseLinearAttentionMetadata(
+            current_timestep=0,
+            topk_ratio=impl.topk_ratio,
+            protect_upto=_localize_protect_upto(
+                protect_upto,
+                segment_start=start,
+                segment_len=segment_len,
+            ),
+        )
+        output[start:stop] = impl.forward(
+            query[start:stop].unsqueeze(0),
+            key[start:stop].unsqueeze(0),
+            value[start:stop].unsqueeze(0),
+            metadata,
+        )[0]
+    return output
 
 
 def _get_cuda_arch(device_index: int) -> str:
@@ -80,7 +240,8 @@ class SparseLinearAttentionMetadata(AttentionMetadata):

-    topk_ratio: float = 0.1

-        topk_ratio: float = 0.1,

         **kwargs: dict[str, Any],
     ) -> SparseLinearAttentionMetadata:
         return SparseLinearAttentionMetadata(
             current_timestep=current_timestep,
             topk_ratio=topk_ratio,
+            protect_upto=int(kwargs.get("protect_upto", 0) or 0),

reviews.body: The 14:30 UTC CI follow-up snapshot reported conflicts with main on this head; the latest query is UNKNOWN, which does not confirm resolution. I do not have push access to the fork. Please merge main and resolve the conflicts before final CI. The missing run-ci label has been restored and verified via one trigger comment; no duplicate trigger is needed.

CI blocker on this exact head: test_validate_server_args_accepts_sla_attn fails with AttributeError before exercising SLA attention in [unit job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36022059037/job/107709410367).

In python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_minimax_h3_admission.py:614, change the mock target from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.minimax_h3.get_attn_backend to sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.selector.get_attn_backend. validate_server_args imports this function locally from selector, so the former module attribute does not exist; the adjacent backend-override test already uses the correct target. Please run the focused admission tests and unit CI after fixing this test.

The other inspected Base failures are health-check/coverage/aggregate fallout, not 28 independent test regressions. No rerun requested for this deterministic failure. I cannot push to the contributor fork, so leaving the minimal fix here.

The admission-test mock fix is verified by the passing current-head unit job. A new, separate blocker is the CI maintenance gate in [H100 job 107917287553](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36072383332/job/107917287553): it now requires base commit 86b3558b41bd, and reports this head as diverged. I do not have push access to the fork; no bypass label or rerun was requested.

- [Partition 0](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36251418825/job/108430142596), h100-novita9-gpu-67: five initial failures (actual > limit, ms): Wan2.2 T2V load 78853.0987 > 77290.55; Wan2.1 T2V 14B load 71065.9901 > 56501.575; JoyEcho load 61053.3569 > 57917.2875; Qwen extra-high E2E 13137.0159 > 12348.175; non-square ZImage load 43122.7002 > 38343.95. Retry was not started: 664.0s remaining < 728.5s required.
- [Partition 1](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36251418825/job/108430142627), h100-novita9-gpu-01: after one failed-item retry, only LTX2.5 diffusion decoder average denoise remains, 403.9494 > 314.148 ms. - [Partition 2](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36251418825/job/108430142645), h100-novita9-gpu-23: after one retry, LTX2 two-stage average denoise 148.4751 > 142.296 ms and LTX2.3 two-stage TI2V refinement 879.1391 > 838.1625 ms remain; three load failures recovered.
